# VAILE — Drop 001

> Heavyweight utility trousers engineered from 12oz raw cotton duck canvas. Built for longevity, movement, and everyday wear.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand**: VAILE (Design atelier based in Bangalore, India)
- **Website**: https://vaile.co
- **Philosophy**: Single-garment focus. Rejecting fast-fashion seasonal turnover in favor of long-term utility, durability, and refined modern proportions.
- **Current Edition**: Drop 001 (Limited to 50 individually numbered pairs).

## Product Specifications: Drop 001
- **Garment**: Heavyweight Utility Trousers
- **Fabric**: 12 oz/yd² (407 GSM) 100% Long-Staple Ring-Spun Cotton Duck Canvas.
- **Weave**: Dense, balanced 1-over-1 plain weave. Naturally wind-resistant and snag-resistant.
- **Finish**: Raw & unwashed (loom-state). No synthetic softening chemicals or pre-distressing.
- **Shrinkage**: Pre-stabilized (< 1.5% residual warp shrink).
- **Cut / Silhouette**: Mid-high rise, relaxed through the thigh (2.5" ease), straight leg falling plumb from hip to hem with zero artificial taper.
- **Reinforcements**: Dual-plane double-layer knees, solid brass rivets at pocket corners, 42 industrial bar-tack stitches, and Tex-80 poly-cotton core-spun structural thread.
- **Pockets**: Symmetrical front utility pockets with 9.5-inch deep 12oz canvas pocket bags.
- **Price**: ₹6,200 INR / $100 USD (Includes shipping & applicable taxes).
